verdict.rationale: Swell documents webhooks that subscribe to any number of model events and call a URL when an event occurs. It also offers serverless functions for custom logic, and JSON models that come with lifecycle events, so developers can build event-driven actions in code. However, the evidence never shows a rule-definition layer: no conditional triggers, workflow builder or declarative automation rules. It also never says outright that functions fire on events, so actions effectively mean outgoing webhook calls or custom code. Missing for 10: declarative or conditional rule definition, explicit event-triggered function execution, in-platform action types beyond outgoing webhooks, independent or hands-on corroboration.
